work.title: Work
work.metaDescription: Selected brand, web and digital product work by Oeuvre, an Auckland studio: BeiCare, MUZI, Folio and ACE.
work.intro: Selected projects. Each one taken from first idea to the thing people use.

projects.name: BeiCare
projects.outcome: Natural skincare, freshly made in New Zealand — the shop people see, and the iPad app that runs the workshop behind it.

hero.alt: The BeiCare website: a glass flask of oil over dried flowers, with the line “Freshly made, naturally cared.”

projects.brief: A small maker blends hydrosols, oils and balms by hand in small batches. The shop had to feel as fresh as the product. The workshop needed one calm screen that says what to make today.
did: Shaped the shop around the product: botanical, warm, made in small batches.
Designed an iPad instrument panel for the workshop: today's batches, stock and work, on one screen.
Made every action direct — drag a batch, tap a line, done.
Built it bilingual: English first, Chinese one tap away.
projects.result: The shop is live at beicare.co.nz. The workshop app is in daily use on iPad.

gallery.alt: The BeiCare website on a phone.
Workshop app — screens with demo data to come.
gallery.caption: Workshop app. Screens with demo data to come.

projects.name: MUZI
projects.outcome: A New Zealand home and garden brand, from the soil bag to the online shop.

hero.alt: The MUZI website: four hand-made glazed pots on a pale background.

projects.brief: A specialist range of succulent soils, stones and pots needed to look as considered as the plants they hold — on the shelf, in store and online.
did: Shaped the identity and the voice: Home & Garden, quiet and earthy.
Photographed the range in one consistent light.
Organised a catalogue of around three hundred products.
Built the shop at muzi.co.nz and the retail material around it.
projects.result: The shop is live at muzi.co.nz, with stock in Auckland retail.

gallery.alt: The ‘New in’ row of the MUZI shop: soil bags and granules.
An echeveria top-dressed with 2–4 mm Maifan stone.
The MUZI shop on a phone.

projects.name: Folio
projects.outcome: A quiet reading app with a daily edition you can read or listen to.

hero.alt: Five Folio articles side by side on iPhone: environment, space, technology, business and world.

projects.brief: Reading apps shout. Folio had to feel like a well-made paper: a daily edition with a beginning and an end, read or narrated, then put down.
did: Designed a daily edition with a clear start and finish.
Set the type for long reading, in light and dark.
Chose a calm, natural narration voice and built background listening with lock-screen controls.
Kept the whole pipeline small enough to run every day.

gallery.alt: Folio concept board: onboarding, interests, the daily edition, an article and membership.
A Folio article: “XRISM sees a pulsar catch stellar wind”.

projects.name: ACE
projects.outcome: A music player built around a reel of tape.
projects.brief: Music apps reduce a track to a progress bar. ACE gives it a body again: a tape reel that turns while the music plays, and that you turn to move through it.
did: Made a tape reel the centre of the player, labelled like a tape box: title, date, master format.
The reel turns with the music: one full turn every twenty seconds.
Grab the reel and turn it to scrub, forwards or back.
Kept everything else quiet: one play button, a countdown, a plain track list.
projects.result: A private tool, used every day on one Mac.

gallery.alt: The ACE player: the reel, a play button, the countdown and the tape label.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.metaDescription: How oeuvre.co.nz handles your information: analytics, the talking figure on the home page, and your rights under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020.
privacy.lead: What we collect, why we need it, and who is involved in handling it. Here it is, plainly.

p: Oeuvre is a trading name of BNB Management Consulting Ltd, based in Auckland, New Zealand.
We are responsible for this website and for the information collected through it.
If you have any questions, write to info@bnbmanagement.co.nz.
We use Microsoft Clarity to understand how the site is used: the pages visited, time spent, scrolling and clicks, device and browser type, and the general region of the visit.
This helps us find designs that are not intuitive, features that are broken, and experiences that need improving.
Clarity uses cookies to recognise repeat visits and may record how a page is used. In those recordings, anything typed into the chat box and the conversation text is masked.
Microsoft processes this data under its own privacy policy and stores it under its own retention rules.

sections.h: The figure on the home page
p: The figure on the home page is made of pre-recorded video. It does not use your camera.
If you choose to talk to it, the text you type, or the transcript of your speech, is sent to Anthropic, where Claude writes the reply. The reply is then passed to ElevenLabs to be turned into speech.
To understand what visitors need and keep improving the site, we keep the conversation text on our server for up to 90 days.

Saved conversations carry no IP address, and email addresses and phone numbers are masked automatically. We also use Claude to tidy the previous day's conversations into a short summary that is emailed to the site team.
**Please do not share private or sensitive information in the chat that you would not want us to see.**
To prevent abuse, we record message counts and service costs, and keep a hashed form of your IP address briefly, cleared after about an hour.

Speech recognition is provided by your browser and is only active while you hold the space bar or actively tap the microphone. Some browsers may send the recording to their provider to be transcribed.
The site is hosted by Hostinger. The server may keep standard access logs, including IP address, time of visit and the page requested.
The site's fonts are loaded through Google Fonts. In that process, Google may receive your IP address.
We also save a few site preferences on your device, such as the sound setting and whether you have seen the opening animation. These settings stay in your browser only.
Some of the providers we use, including Microsoft, Anthropic, ElevenLabs, Google and Hostinger, may process data outside New Zealand, including in the United States.
These providers handle information under their own privacy policies. We choose third parties according to what the service needs and pay attention to how they protect data.
If you contact us, we use the information you give to reply, to discuss working together or to handle your request.
These messages are kept for as long as is needed to do the work and to keep reasonable records, and are not used for unrelated purposes.
Under the New Zealand Privacy Act 2020, you have the right to ask for the personal information we hold about you and to ask for it to be corrected.
Please contact us at info@bnbmanagement.co.nz.
If you are not happy with how we handle your information, you can also contact the New Zealand Office of the Privacy Commissioner (privacy.org.nz).
When the way we collect or use information changes, we will update this page.
The date at the top shows the latest version.
